title: PolarisDesktopBootstrapPrimitives
description: The shell facts the renderer needs before it can draw anything, and nothing else. Every member is bounded; there is no free-form configuration object and no path into host internals.
$comment: حقائق القشرة وحدها. ما ليس مطلوبًا للرسم لا يعبر الحدّ: لا أسرار، ولا مسارات، ولا داخليات سياسة، ولا مقابض أصلية.

Platform.title: Platform
Platform.description: Host platform. MACOS is representable because the host is cross-platform by construction; Phase-01 measures and claims WINDOWS only.

Locale.title: Locale
Locale.description: The nine architectural locales. Phase-01 proves ar and en; the other seven resolve through fallback and are still representable so that adding one is a resource change, not a contract change.

Direction.title: Direction
Direction.description: Writing direction. Derived by the host from the locale, never from a manual toggle.

Appearance.title: Appearance
Appearance.description: Resolved appearance preference. SYSTEM means the host defers to the operating system setting.

RuntimeReachability.title: RuntimeReachability
RuntimeReachability.description: Whether the trusted POLARIS core is attached to this host. In Phase-01 the honest value is NOT_ATTACHED: the seam is drawn and left unbuilt, and the shell says so rather than implying a running core.

RuntimeStatus.title: RuntimeStatus

runtime_contract_version.description: Present only when a runtime is actually attached and declared its contract version. Absent is honest; an invented version is not.

RuntimeStatus.description: Runtime reachability and posture. Facts only: no process id, no path, no environment, no stack trace.

BootstrapSnapshot.title: BootstrapSnapshot

enabled_capabilities.description: Capabilities the host will actually answer for right now. An empty array is a valid and honest answer.

unavailable_capabilities.description: Everything the shell can name but cannot use, each with a state and a machine reason.

BootstrapSnapshot.description: The complete Phase-01 bootstrap fact set. additionalProperties is false, so a host that grows a new fact must change this contract in the open.
